set.body:
Implement one sample-loss QC primitive and result export through existing result conventions. Define observed/lost/blink/interpolated and unknown classifications, per-eye and trial denominators, empty input and irregular-time behavior; preserve row accounting. Acceptance: independent hand-counted fixtures, public consumer test, stable diagnostics and tidy export, no threshold chosen from evaluated data. Queue precision/accuracy summaries and the full quality-report workflow; this slice does not qualify QC.

Keep each implementation review below roughly half a day; if the scope exceeds that, split before implementation and retain the parent acceptance. Follow repository law/mutation and landing gates. This is required gap work owned by the comparison epic; completion needs evidence, not title closure.
set.title: PM1.3 Add a typed sample-loss quality summary with explicit denominators
